name: 须佐能乎·十拳剑
description: 万花筒。选择3格内的一个敌人，造成200%攻击力的魔法伤害，并使其所有主动技能进入2回合冷却。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var caster = context.piece; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 3, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var damage = Math.round(caster.attack * context.skill.powerMultiplier); var result = dealDamage(caster, target, damage, 'magical', battle, context.skill.id); if (target.skills) target.skills.forEach(function(skillState) { var definition = battle.skillsById && battle.skillsById[skillState.skillId]; if (!definition || definition.kind === 'active') skillState.currentCooldown = Math.max(skillState.currentCooldown || 0, 2); }); return { success: true, message: caster.name + '以十拳剑对' + target.name + '造成' + result.damage + '点魔法伤害，并使其所有主动技能进入至少2回合冷却' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece, skillDef) { var damage = Math.round((piece.attack || 0) * skillDef.powerMultiplier); return { description: '选择3格内的一个敌人，造成' + damage + '点魔法伤害，并使其所有主动技能进入2回合冷却。', expectedValues: { damage: damage, cooldown: 2 } }; }
